errors.text: The proposed Cr addition does not reconstruct the Ti-containing, rapidly quenched fcc/C14 dual-phase intervention.
The sole cited evidence does not support increased coercivity; it instead reports that 25% Cr can render FeCoNiCr paramagnetic.
No evidence links the hypothesized bcc or bcc+fcc structure to coercivity enhancement in this alloy.

The hypothesis omits the phase-specific magnetic transitions, antiferromagnetic Ti-sublattice coupling, interface/domain-wall pinning mechanism, and elevated-temperature coercivity central to the target.
